content.short: Connect businesses and customers through our rewards and community engagement program.
content.description:
Clanity strives to build a self-sustaining community all over the world by connecting businesses with their customers through our blockchain rewards and engagement program. Clanity is the first blockchain technology that attempts to simplify and efficiently reward a large number of individuals who make subjective contributions to local businesses all around the world with a universal utility token. Clanity as a solution:

Underutilized blockchain-based value additions Blockchain is the most disruptive technology of the century but its adoption has not been warmly welcomed by the masses due to its technicality and lack of real world use case.

Introduce Blockchain in the underrepresented rewards functions We will provide a platform that is easy to use and of value so our community will have sustainable massive gains from joining Clanity which will be the catalyst for adoption.

Online competitors challenging local physical retailers With e-commerce and online retailers building market share over the past decade, brick-and-mortar companies are in trouble trying to keep up. This trend is causing less foot traffic to traditional business.

Bring foot traffic to business partners We will be reinventing the process of how businesses acquire new loyal customers. Clanity will offer efficient ways of targeting customers and effectively convert them into purchasing customers.

Inefficient rewards programs About 50% of loyalty program members are inactive. Many never engage or they opt out after a month. It lacks differentiation, fails to gain attention or attract new members and retain existing members.

Universally revolutionize the rewards program Clanity puts the customer at the center of our rewards program to drive results by enabling technologies that enhance the customer experience, and offer value propositions that are financially incremental.

Decreased funding in local public schools Countries are already cutting their education budgets to make space for the required spending on health and social protection. The hugely affected students mostly fall disproportionately on the poorest and most vulnerable.

Supports low funded schools or high impact nonprofit organizations Part of Clanity’s goal is to support low funded schools and high impact nonprofits to ensure that the younger generation is well equipped to take over the responsibilities of world innovation.

Data exploit by corporate giants Once you sign the terms of service online to use a software, the organization gains control over your data. It might be surprising to know that not all major companies sell data because it is valuable. Companies that do sell data, get the money and the users get nothing.

Users control and own their data We respect our users' privacy. We want our users to have control and own their data. Allowing users to sell their own data for self-monetization to business partners may be integrated to the platform in the future if there is a huge demand. Clanity is a blockchain technology hoping to return the power of finance back to the end users to promote financial inclusion. Once Clanity is fully and universally adopted, a cycle will then be established through the platform building self-sustaining communities, one town at a time, all over the world.
